vulnerable_function.name: FUN_710003b470
vulnerable_function.description: Frame data extractor — copies parsed payload to output struct
vulnerable_function.explanation: memcpy(output+0x78, payload_ptr, payload_size) where payload_size comes from parsed frame body via vtable[4] with NO bounds check against destination buffer size (0x798 - 0x78 = 0x720 available)

step1_receive.action: WiFi driver receives 802.11 action frame via vtable[0x120/8]
step1_receive.cap: 0x57c (1404 bytes) max frame, copied to ring buffer slot of 0x5e8 (1512 bytes)

step3_parse.action: Creates packet parser object, parses body starting at offset 12

body_parser.action: JUST STORES RAW POINTER if body > 0x27 bytes — NO size validation

step4_extract.action: Calls vtable[2] to parse/decrypt, vtable[4] to get payload_size, vtable[3] to get payload_ptr, then memcpy

overflow.destination: output struct array element at param_3 + iVar20 * 0x798
overflow.size_source: vtable[4] reads from parser state (raw frame body pointer)

step5_consumer.action: Main frame processing loop — peeks ring buffer, calls parse chain, sorts results

plaintext.authentication: NONE — attacker fully controls all fields

aes_gcm.authentication: AES-128-GCM — requires group key to forge valid frames

body.contains: encrypted/plaintext payload with embedded payload_size field

requirements: 802.11 monitor mode + packet injection capability (PC phy0 confirmed)
Switch in ldn/lp2p active mode (Send to Smartphone, local wireless play)
Knowledge of lp2p group parameters for valid frame construction
For GCM sessions: group encryption key (from key exchange observation)
For plaintext: just craft and inject frames
mitigations_absent: No bounds check on payload_size before memcpy
mitigations_present: NX — need ROP for code execution
